 Cloudy for Trick or Treating with showers moving in Sunday 
 Meteorologist Belle Oliver is tracking a soggy end to the weekend. 
 By Belle Oliver Published : Oct. 31, 2026 at 5:56 PM EDT | Updated : Oct. 31, 2026 at 10:09 PM EDT Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google KNOXVILLE, Tenn. (WVLT) - Mostly cloudy skies with scattered rain chances are expected on the back half of your weekend with higher rain chances by mid-week.
 TRICK OR TREATING TONIGHT: Mostly cloudy skies are expected this evening. Temperatures will be in the 60s before cooling off into the 50s during the overnight hours.
 SUNDAY: Mostly cloudy skies are expected on Sunday with a 40% chance of showers. Spotty showers are expected in the morning hours, becoming more scattered by Sunday evening. The high will be 67 degrees.
 Sunday Rain (WVLT) EARLY WORK WEEK: Some lingering showers are possible on Monday with highs back in the 70s. It will be slightly warmer on Tuesday with partly cloudy skies. 
 MID-WEEK: Mostly cloudy skies are expected on Wednesday and Thursday with a 40% chance of showers each day. The heaviest rainfall will likely fall Wednesday night. There is a low end chance of flooding.
